t: A self-declared republic in former British Somaliland, which broke away from Somalia on 18 May 1991.
It built peace through clan conferences and combines an elected president and parliament with a house of elders.
It has its own army, currency and passports and holds competitive elections, but recognition remains very limited.
dyk: In 1960 British Somaliland was independent for only five days, from 26 June to 1 July, before uniting with Somalia; Somaliland’s claim rests on that brief statehood.
ev: British Somaliland is independent for five days, then unites with Somalia
Government forces bombard Hargeisa and Burao in the war with the SNM
Independence is declared at Burao on 18 May
The Borama conference chooses Muhammad Haji Ibrahim Egal as president
A referendum approves the constitution and independence
Silanyo defeats the incumbent president and power passes peacefully
Somaliland forces are driven from positions around Las Anod
Israel becomes the first UN member state to recognise Somaliland

f.founder: Somali National Movement (Abdirahman Ahmed Ali Tuur, first president)
f.predecessor: Somali Democratic Republic; State of Somaliland (1960)
